applicability: Reviewed Concepts where a direct answer has user value
publication_rule: Metadata does not authorize one thin page per query
review_requirement: Query must resolve to one active source-verified Concept

applicability: Reviewed relations and explicit confusion pairs
publication_rule: Create comparison surfaces only where distinct user value exists
review_requirement: Both Concepts and their distinction/relation must be reviewed

applicability: Concepts with material jurisdiction-specific meaning or labels
publication_rule: Do not manufacture country pages from templates
review_requirement: Jurisdiction claim must already exist in reviewed Concept/label evidence

applicability: Mechanics that support a substantive explanatory answer
review_requirement: Must identify the specific mechanic and evidence boundary
Translation/equivalence status must come from reviewed master data

publication_rule: No standalone thin page for a code alone
review_requirement: Abbreviation must resolve to an active Concept and retain locale/currentness

applicability: Codes/terms users encounter in racecards, results or official documents
publication_rule: Prefer consolidated reader guides where that has more value
review_requirement: Source context must support document/racecard use
